**Model Table Generation (Origin & Destination)**

```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

# ==========================================
# 1. Load/Clean data
# ==========================================
history <- read_csv("features_history_dev.csv.gz")
weather <- read_csv("weather_10airports_2025JanSep.csv.gz")

weather <- weather %>%
  mutate(
    valid = force_tz(valid, tzone = "UTC"),
    gust = as.numeric(gust),
    p01i = as.numeric(p01i)
  ) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(valid)) %>% 
  arrange(iata, valid)

flights <- read_csv("flights_closed10_dev_2025JanJun.csv.gz") %>%
  left_join(history, by = "flight_id") %>%
  mutate(
    cutoff_utc = force_tz(cutoff_utc, tzone = "UTC"),
    scheduled_dep = cutoff_utc + minutes(120),
    scheduled_arr = scheduled_dep + minutes(CRSElapsedTime), 
    dep_hour = hour(scheduled_dep),
    arr_hour = hour(scheduled_arr)
  )

# ==========================================
# 2. Origin weather
# ==========================================
weather_cols <- c("sknt", "gust", "vsby", "p01i")

# Origin C (Clean)
flights <- flights %>%
  left_join(
    weather %>% select(iata, valid, all_of(weather_cols)),
    by = join_by(Origin == iata, closest(cutoff_utc >= valid))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    valid_C = valid,
    is_within_120m = as.numeric(difftime(cutoff_utc, valid_C, units = "mins")) <= 120
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(weather_cols), ~ ifelse(is_within_120m, .x, NA))) %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_C"), all_of(weather_cols)) %>%
  select(-valid, -is_within_120m)

# Origin W (Leaked)
flights <- flights %>%
  left_join(
    weather %>% select(iata, valid, all_of(weather_cols)),
    by = join_by(Origin == iata, closest(scheduled_dep >= valid))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    valid_W = valid,
    is_leaked_window = valid_W > cutoff_utc & valid_W <= scheduled_dep
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(weather_cols), ~ ifelse(is_leaked_window, .x, NA))) %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_W"), all_of(weather_cols)) %>%
  select(-valid, -is_leaked_window)

# ==========================================
# 3. Destination Weatehr
# ==========================================

# Dest C (Clean)
flights <- flights %>%
  left_join(
    weather %>% select(iata, valid, all_of(weather_cols)),
    by = join_by(Dest == iata, closest(cutoff_utc >= valid))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    valid_Dest_C = valid,
    is_within_120m = as.numeric(difftime(cutoff_utc, valid_Dest_C, units = "mins")) <= 120
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(weather_cols), ~ ifelse(is_within_120m, .x, NA))) %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_Dest_C"), all_of(weather_cols)) %>%
  select(-valid, -is_within_120m)

# Dest W_dep (Leaked, based on scheduled departure)
flights <- flights %>%
  left_join(
    weather %>% select(iata, valid, all_of(weather_cols)),
    by = join_by(Dest == iata, closest(scheduled_dep >= valid))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    valid_Dest_W_dep = valid,
    is_leaked_window_dep = valid_Dest_W_dep > cutoff_utc & valid_Dest_W_dep <= scheduled_dep
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(weather_cols), ~ ifelse(is_leaked_window_dep, .x, NA))) %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_Dest_W_dep"), all_of(weather_cols)) %>%
  select(-valid, -is_leaked_window_dep)

# Dest W_arr (Leaked, based on scheduled arrival)
flights <- flights %>%
  left_join(
    weather %>% select(iata, valid, all_of(weather_cols)),
    by = join_by(Dest == iata, closest(scheduled_arr >= valid))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    valid_Dest_W_arr = valid,
    is_leaked_window_arr = valid_Dest_W_arr > cutoff_utc & valid_Dest_W_arr <= scheduled_arr
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(weather_cols), ~ ifelse(is_leaked_window_arr, .x, NA))) %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_Dest_W_arr"), all_of(weather_cols)) %>%
  select(-valid, -is_leaked_window_arr)

# ==========================================
# 4. Export
# ==========================================

model_table_dev <- flights %>%
  select(
    flight_id, Origin, Dest, cutoff_utc, scheduled_dep, scheduled_arr, 
    dep_hour, arr_hour, 
    contains("_C"), contains("_W"), 
    DepDelay, TaxiOut, 
    everything()
  )

# Randomly pick 3 flights for checking
model_table_dev %>%
  select(flight_id, Dest, cutoff_utc, valid_Dest_C, scheduled_dep, valid_Dest_W_dep, scheduled_arr, valid_Dest_W_arr) %>%
  sample_n(3) %>%
  print()

# Export
write_csv(model_table_dev, "model_table_dev.csv.gz")
```
